refusal.policy: refuse entire gradient for invalid indices, nonfinite inputs, singular division and nonfinite intermediates/results

entry_points.adjoint_phases: Launch ad then ad_clear in that order on the same CUDA stream, checking refusal records before publishing gradients. The incoming output cotangent buffers and outgoing input cotangent buffers are disjoint; the final phase consumes the former.

workspace.refusal_ownership: One int32 slot per source ID; device threads set the slot atomically; any nonzero slot refuses the derivative.
workspace.initialization: zero all records before each launch; inspect all records and refuse the entire derivative if any is nonzero
workspace.aliases: all distinct primal, tangent, cotangent and failure buffers are disjoint, except the explicitly described in-place tangent buffers
workspace.accumulation: Each destination has one owner. Duplicate cotangent contributions are gathered in fixed index order into a float64 register, then rounded once into the float32 destination; no unordered floating-point atomics.
workspace.refusal_device_layout: int32 per source ID, initialized to zero; any nonzero value refuses the derivative

implementation_status: draft: branch records implemented; branch-case and exceptional-input proofs are incomplete

seed_lifetime.mask: forward threads edge < nedges, each tracer and level
seed_lifetime.zero_work: no output slots overwritten and no seed slots cleared
seed_lifetime.launch_contract: Use the pinned host wrapper geometry, which covers its count. The final phase also preserves slots outside any partial forward write mask.
